leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a regular expression literal using forward slashes
Apply the test() method to check if a pattern matches a string
Implement the match() method to extract substrings that match a pattern
Configure character classes to match specific sets of characters
Manipulate strings using the replace() method with regular expressions
Initialize a RegExp object with dynamic patterns using the constructor
Control pattern matching behavior using flags like 'g' and 'i'
